answer: At dawn, an agent may earn voting weight only by completing a sequence of escrowed jobs whose results are checked by randomly assigned peers with established stake. Repeated identities do not multiply influence: each new account must lock additional funds, and inconsistent work can forfeit them. A prism-style audit samples linked jobs for collusion, while shale records make payouts and penalties traceable. The attacker must therefore risk capital and sustain costly, verifiable work across many identities.
